title.zh: 平行社会：一句闲话怎么挤垮一家钱庄
title.en: A parallel society: how one remark brings down a bank
Nobody responds: the bank is run to failure

hint.zh: 更夫夜里看见钱庄往外抬箱子。看这句话怎么传开、走样，队伍怎么排起来。钱庄其实并不亏空。点任何一个人看他怎么想。
hint.en: A night watchman sees boxes carried out of the bank. Watch the remark spread and distort and the queue form. The bank is in fact sound. Click anyone to see what they think.

title.zh: 同一座城，有人出面担保：钱庄撑住
title.en: The same town with a credible guarantee: the bank holds

hint.zh: 和上一张是同一座城、同一句话，只多了第三天早上官银号的担保。对比两条世界线差在哪里。
hint.en: Same town and same remark as the previous card, plus a guarantee from the official bank on the third morning. Compare where the two worlds part.

title.en: Protagonists played by a language model

hint.zh: 十一个有名有姓的人物由模型决定怎么想、怎么办、对人说什么。这里跟着更夫老周：箱子是他亲眼看见的，四十块钱是他的老本。在这个世界里钱庄撑住了。
hint.en: Eleven named characters have a model decide what they think, do and say. This one follows Old Zhou the night watchman, who saw the boxes himself and has forty yuan of savings at stake. In this world the bank holds.

title.zh: 丰川信用金库，1973：一句玩笑

hint.zh: 按史料的时间线重演：通勤列车上的一句玩笑，一周后成了挤兑。这是像史料的一个世界：第 6 天起挤兑、少数人取款、担保后平息、金库撑住。换种子，这样的世界很少，多数世界里玩笑不了了之。
hint.en: A replay on the recorded timeline: a joke on a commuter train becomes a bank run a week later. This is a world that resembles the record: a run from day 6, a minority withdrawing, calm after the guarantee, the bank surviving. Across seeds such worlds are rare; in most the joke goes nowhere.

title.zh: 东亚银行，2008：一条群发短信
title.en: Bank of East Asia, 2008: a mass text message

hint.zh: 史料里只提走了 0.67% 的存款，银行没倒。模型最初在这里错得离谱（人人都去取），据此重新设计过「谁会去取」；现在规模对上了，但它已经是拟合过的案例，不算检验。
hint.en: In the record 0.67% of deposits left and the bank held. The model first got this badly wrong (everyone withdrew), and who withdraws was redesigned because of it; the scale now matches, but this is a fitted case and no longer a test.

title.en: The lab: intervene at this moment

hint.zh: 停在第三天上午，钱庄还没倒。在右侧选一种干预加入，点「分叉重跑」，时间轴上虚线是原来那条世界线。
hint.en: Paused on the third morning, before the bank fails. Pick an intervention on the right, add it and press the fork button; the dashed lines on the timeline are the original world.

title.zh: 依据：理论、案例、事实与校准
title.en: Evidence: theories, cases, facts and calibration

hint.zh: 模拟依据的 12 张理论卡、13 个案例、10 条典型事实，逐条标明出处是否核实；以及校准对上了什么、没对上什么。
hint.en: The 12 theory cards, 13 cases and 10 stylised facts behind the simulation, each marked with whether its sources were checked, and what calibration did and did not match.

summary.zh: 平行社会：一个小镇上谣言怎么传开、怎么变成挤兑。这里有它依据的语料（理论、案例、典型事实，每条有出处和核实标记）、校准的目标、人口用的年龄结构，以及一个计算：按场景和种子跑一次模拟，返回摘要。先看 facts 和 cases；要跑模拟调 simulate。注意：这个模型没有通过样本外检验，结果不是对真实银行的预测。
summary.en: A parallel society: how a rumour spreads through a small town and turns into a bank run. Offered here are the corpus it rests on (theories, cases and stylised facts, each with sources and verification flags), the calibration targets, the age structures used for its populations, and one computation: run a simulation for a scenario and seed and get a summary. Start with facts and cases; call simulate to run one. Note that the model has not passed its out-of-sample tests, so a result is not a forecast for any real bank.

description.zh: 社会传播的理论卡：门槛、复杂传染、从众、谣言、挤兑等，写明机制、可观察的推论、在引擎里实现到哪一步。
description.en: Theory cards on social spread: thresholds, complex contagion, conformity, rumour, bank runs and more, each with its mechanism, observable implications and how far the engine implements it.

datasets.licence: MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: 每条的 sources 里逐个写明出处，以及有没有核实（verified / checked）；caveats 字段写明了没能核对的地方。有英文版在 en 字段里。
provenance.en: Each entry lists its sources one by one with whether they were verified (`verified` / `checked`); the `caveats` field states what could not be checked. An English version sits under `en`.

description.zh: 文学典故和有记录的真实挤兑（八起），模拟的场景以它们为蓝本；真实案例带日期、金额和比例。
description.en: Literary cases and eight documented real bank runs on which the simulated scenarios are modelled; the real ones carry dates, amounts and shares.

datasets.licence: MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: 每条的 sources 里逐个写明出处，以及有没有核实（verified / checked）；caveats 字段写明了没能核对的地方。有英文版在 en 字段里。
provenance.en: Each entry lists its sources one by one with whether they were verified (`verified` / `checked`); the `caveats` field states what could not be checked. An English version sits under `en`.

description.zh: 带数值、单位、适用条件和注意事项的经验发现。
description.en: Empirical findings with a value, a unit, the conditions they hold under and caveats.

datasets.licence: MIT (text paraphrased and written for this repository; cited works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: 每条的 sources 里逐个写明出处，以及有没有核实（verified / checked）；caveats 字段写明了没能核对的地方。有英文版在 en 字段里。
provenance.en: Each entry lists its sources one by one with whether they were verified (`verified` / `checked`); the `caveats` field states what could not be checked. An English version sits under `en`.

description.zh: 模型校准时要对上的八个指标：区间、出处、为什么选它。同一个文件的 calibrated.metrics 是校准后的实际值，有三个没落在区间里。
description.en: The eight metrics the model is calibrated against: the interval, the source and why it was chosen. In the same file, calibrated.metrics holds the values actually reached; three fall outside their intervals.

provenance.zh: 每个目标的 source 字段指向语料里的一条事实或案例。区间里有几条下限是本项目自己定的，why 字段里写明了。
provenance.en: Each target's `source` points to a fact or case in the corpus. Some floors were set by this project, as the `why` field says.

description.zh: 各场景所在地、所在年份五个年龄组的人数，用来生成合成人口。
description.en: Head counts in five age groups for the place and year of each scenario, used to synthesise populations.

provenance.zh: 联合国《世界人口展望 2024》，经 Our World in Data 的「Population by age group」取得，五个年龄组是它加总的，这里没有改动。通和场景是虚构的，取的是中国 1950 年的数字。
provenance.en: United Nations, World Population Prospects 2024, obtained through Our World in Data's "Population by age group"; the five groups are its sums and nothing was altered here. The fictional Tonghe scenario takes China's 1950 figures.

description.zh: 按场景、种子和回应方式跑一次，返回摘要：银行倒没倒、多少储户去取、取走多少、哪天起挤兑，以及逐日的知情、相信、排队、已取人数和准备金。不调用模型，不写文件。史料场景的 record 字段是史料里的数字，可以对照。
description.en: Runs one simulation for a scenario, seed and response and returns a summary: whether the bank failed, what share of depositors withdrew, how much left, the day the run began, and day-by-day counts of those aware, believing, queueing and paid, with the reserve. No model is called and nothing is written. For historical scenarios the `record` field gives the recorded figures for comparison.

scenario.description: 场景：rumor_run 是虚构的通和钱庄，其余按史料搭 / the scenario: rumor_run is the fictional Tonghe Bank, the rest follow historical records

seed.description: 随机种子；同一个种子得到同一个世界 / random seed; the same seed gives the same world

response.description: 谁出面回应：notice 是场景里原有的回应，guarantee 是可信一方担保，none 是无人回应 / who responds: notice is the scenario's own response, guarantee a guarantee from a credible party, none nobody

calibrated.description: 用校准过的参数 / use the calibrated parameters

output.zh: 一个 JSON 对象：input、ticks、depositors、failed_at_hour（没倒是 null）、runner_share、withdrawn_share、run_day（没发生挤兑是 null）、peak_believers、by_day（逐日数字）、record（史料数字，虚构场景是 null）、caveat。
output.en: One JSON object: input, ticks, depositors, failed_at_hour (null if the bank held), runner_share, withdrawn_share, run_day (null if no run happened), peak_believers, by_day (day-by-day figures), record (the recorded figures; null for the fictional scenario) and caveat.
